name: @calimero-network/mero-pass
description: Mero Pass vault crypto and session logic for browsers and Node: open, read and write an end-to-end encrypted Mero Pass vault, as the app or as an agent (mero-bot).
// exports: In the workspace the app and tests read the TypeScript source, so nothing
has to be built before a typecheck. `publishConfig` swaps in the built
files when `pnpm pack` makes the tarball the publish workflow uploads.

scripts.build: rm -rf dist && esbuild src/index.ts --bundle --platform=neutral --target=es2020 --format=esm --outfile=dist/index.mjs --sourcemap && esbuild src/index.ts --bundle --platform=neutral --target=es2020 --format=cjs --outfile=dist/index.cjs --sourcemap && tsc -p tsconfig.build.json

author: Calimero Ltd
